decisions.reason: Only a brief website mention still indicates limited public commitment, but accumulated sunk engineering costs and the firm's responsibility for the product line make near-term withdrawal unlikely despite its peripheral fit.

Its dedicated page is a visible commitment and development costs are sunk, so although the spring-balanced desk lamp does not align strongly with the smart-lighting direction, escalation of commitment keeps it in the portfolio.
As a core interior luminaire with its own page and active model range, it is central to the announced direction and carries high sunk investment, making a quick drop very unlikely.

The product is the firm's publicly presented flagship and highly central to its announced sustainable and intelligent lighting direction, so the strong commitment and sunk resources make withdrawal very improbable.

The marine HMI searchlight remains only briefly mentioned and outside the core LED/human-centric direction, so commitment is thin; though sunk costs still argue for persistence, its low centrality raises the chance of withdrawal.
